title: Line OpenChat users in Thailand rise to 24 million after app redesign
summary: Line OpenChat users in Thailand rise to 24 million after app redesign
detailed: Line Thailand announced its OpenChat service reached 24 million monthly active users, up from 20 million.
The growth followed the integration of a redesigned community discovery interface into the third tab of the Line application.
The update successfully transitioned the platform toward structured, interest-based user segments.
This matters because it demonstrates how targeted community discovery UI updates can successfully drive user engagement and platform growth.
